title: WPSS/2612/2018 of Angan Ram AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
MCC No.12344/2018 (Application for Amendment)
IN
WPSS No.2162 of 2018
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Rajendra Arya, Advocate for
the petitioner.
Mr. Sushil Vashistha, Brief
Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
Learned counsel for the
petitioner seeks permission to
withdraw the amendment application
as well as present writ petition so far
petitioner no.1 is concerned with
liberty to file fresh writ petition.
Permission is granted.
Writ petition is dismissed as
withdrawn so far petitioner no.1 is
concerned with liberty to file fresh writ
petition.
Learned counsel for the parties
submitted that the controversy
involved in this petition is squarely
covered by the judgment given by the
coordinate Bench of this Court on
20.06.2018 in WPSS No.562 of 2018.
They prayed that present petition be
decided in terms of the judgment given
by the coordinate Bench of this Court
on 20.06.2018 in WPSS No.562 of
2018.
In view of the statement of the
learned counsel for the parties, the
writ petition is disposed of in terms of
the judgment given by the coordinate
Bench of this Court on 20.06.2018 in
WPSS No.562 of 2018, so far as
petitioner nos.2, 3 & 4 are concerned.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
 13.09.2018
A.kaur
